size_note: market-wide; trillions in CHF positions built on the floor
pnl_note: EURCHF gapped far below 1.20 intraday; stops executed with extreme slippage
why_what: On 15 Jan 2015 the SNB discontinued the CHF 1.20 minimum exchange rate vs the euro without warning and cut its rate to -0.75%, saying the overvaluation had decreased while the euro was weakening globally.
how: Anyone long EURCHF at the floor was instantly offside as bids vanished; liquidity disappeared so stop losses filled far below trigger levels, producing losses larger than posted margin.
where_ctx: OTC spot, institutional and leveraged retail; announced Zurich morning, 15 Jan 2015.
lesson: Central bank floors are political decisions that can vanish overnight; gap risk overwhelms stop placement on one-way peg trades.

side: retail follower of published trade ideas
pnl_note: self-reported string of losing trades, including one taken without a stop loss; prior year claimed +21% (unverified)
why_what: A BabyPips member journaling their 2023 trading reports a run of losses while following a blog's chart trade ideas, admitting bad habits are catching up, including a trade with no stop loss.
how: Signal-following with small size and inconsistent risk control: skipped stops and late entries (6-8 hours after idea publication) degraded the edge the signal may have had.
where_ctx: BabyPips public trade journal thread, February 2023.
lesson: Self-reported retail results carry survivorship bias; even here the poster attributes losses to skipped stops, the classic failure mode, not to the strategy.
